alt: One practice cycle on a day line from 0 to 16: a mock contest on day 0, an upsolving stretch starting on day 1, a retry of the stalled problems some days after it ends, and the next mock contest. When the wait is too long the retry lands after the next mock and is marked late.

steps.caption: Day 0 is the mock contest: one sitting of three hours on a past contest, logged as in the earlier figures.
Days 1 to 3 are for upsolving, using the first steps from the log. You are working on problems from one contest while it is fresh.
Day 10 is 7 days after the upsolve ends: retry the problems you stalled on, from a blank file. Whatever you can rebuild now is what you learned.
Day 14 is the next mock contest, which closes the cycle and starts the next log.
Each cycle ends with a retry before the next mock, so a fresh log can show whether it helped.
